sloka: स्त्रीसहस्राणि ते सप्त वशे स्थास्यन्ति सुन्दरि ।रावणं भज भर्तारं भर्तारं सर्वरक्षसाम् ।। ५.२२.३१।।।।
transliteration: strīsahasrāṇi te sapta vaśe sthāsyanti sundari ।rāvaṇaṁ bhaja bhartāraṁ bhartāraṁ sarvarakṣasām ।। 5.22.31।।।।

translations.english: "O Sita you are following a vow of chastity and treading a meaningless, wrong path. I will destroy you as the Sun dispels the morning twilight with his lustre".
